title: With the detail pane split, the list cannot scroll to the rows below its half -- the scroll was taken against the whole body
body:
hv, 2026-09-16, driving the explorer after the quiet-window rebuild (3.0.3 at 3e0a87f23): "2. If the top-half of a view of an issue or thread has more lines than will fit at 50% then its not possible to scroll the list of fields downwards so that the hidden fields are displayed". hv's screenshots (CleanShot 2026-09-16 at 19.48.49, 19.49.22, 19.50.02, 19.50.10, 19.50.13 and 19.50.16) show ST0075's fields with the detail pane open. The cursor is at 17/20 on `design.md` and the pane shows design.md, but the list is painted only down to `info.md`, so the selected row and the rows after it cannot be reached on screen.

The cause: `Screen::first_row` in `tui/layout.rs` scrolled against `body_height`, the whole body under the chrome. `Screen::painted` drew the list in the half `divide` gives it when the body splits, and without the composer frame's lines when it does not. The scroll window was taller than the list on the screen, so the cursor walked into rows nobody painted. The page keys used the same over-tall figure.

The fix gives the list's height one home, `Screen::list_height`, which the scroll, the painter and the page keys all read; `body_height` is deleted.

The in-place edit's extra space at the cursor was reported in the same message as issue 0421; one change fixes both.
